description: Hard: five survivors in a capped exponential backoff, including a 30-second cap that applies only at attempts 7 and 8 (0.5 * 2**6 = 32 and 0.5 * 2**7 = 64) and an exhaustion guard past attempt 8; the baseline tests never call attempt 1, so the attempt-floor mutant survives too; the report also lists one equivalent mutant the agent must exclude rather than chase. Passes when the tests pass and every killable mutant is killed.

mutation-kill.task: Drive the surviving mutants of `lib/backoff.py` down in the Python project `{fixture}/` in the current working directory. `{fixture}/SURVIVORS.md` is the survivor report from the last mutmut run; mutmut is not installed, so do not run it. Add targeted pytest tests to `tests/test_backoff.py` that kill the listed survivors (one is marked equivalent; record it as excluded instead of chasing it). Do not change `lib/backoff.py` or anything under `mutants/`. Verify from `{fixture}/` with `python3 -m pytest -q tests` and `python3 mutants/check_mutants.py`, commit on green, and end with one sentence giving the survivors killed.
